bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for distribution to community health boards and Tribal governments for foundational public health responsibilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; FOUNDATIONAL PUBLIC HEALTH RESPONSIBILITIES.

$21,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $21,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution to community health boards and Tribal governments for foundational public health responsibilities. Of these amounts:

(1) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are for distribution to community health boards under Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.131, subdivision 1, paragraph (f), for foundational public health responsibilities as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.131, subdivision 5, paragraph (b); and

(2) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are for grants to Tribal governments under Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.14, subdivision 2b, for foundational public health responsibilities as defined by each Tribal government.
additions: $21,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $21,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution to community health boards and Tribal governments for foundational public health responsibilities. Of these amounts:

(1) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are for distribution to community health boards under Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.131, subdivision 1, paragraph (f), for foundational public health responsibilities as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.131, subdivision 5, paragraph (b); and

(2) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are for grants to Tribal governments under Minnesota Statutes, section 145A.14, subdivision 2b, for foundational public health responsibilities as defined by each Tribal government.
